## Hypothesis

The BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup can be improved by incorporating a more robust trailing stop mechanism, specifically a chandelier-style exit, to better capture the trend and minimize losses.

## Mechanism

The proposed mechanism involves adding a chandelier-style trailing stop to the existing BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup. This will allow the trade to ride the trend more effectively and minimize losses by adjusting the stop level based on the price movement.
